verdict.rationale: The developer page claims an API for 'full control of your workflow' and Zapier integration, but there is no documentation, OpenAPI spec, or endpoint list demonstrating parity with core UI features like check deposit, registered agent actions, or mail scanning requests. Probes for llms.txt, machine-readable docs, and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, suggesting no discoverable API documentation to verify feature completeness. missing for 10: detailed API reference/OpenAPI spec showing endpoints for every UI action (check deposit, mail scan requests, registered agent, TruLease/TruResidence management), independent confirmation of API-UI feature parity.
